decisions.decision: b-layer token is ONE hover target carrying both bond ends (kind 'bondStereo'), not two 'stereo' atoms
decisions.rationale: The '-' between atom numbers in /b is a separator, not a parity sign; ParityText mis-signed the first atom of every pair (REVIEW H-01)

decisions.decision: The /b card calls the sign a canonical parity and explicitly says it is NOT the E/Z descriptor
decisions.rationale: Same chemical-correctness rule as /t: parity comes from canonical numbering + geometry, not CIP

decisions.decision: Empty-canvas legend is both inert (handler guard) and visibly greyed (CSS), mirroring the InChI box; the explanation card itself is untouched
decisions.rationale: Two separate user reports; the guard fixes behaviour, the greying communicates it. Card precedence logic must stay identical once a molecule exists (UAT-13)

decisions.decision: Pin Node 22 in .nvmrc/engines and bake --no-experimental-webstorage into npm test
decisions.rationale: Node 25 ships a global localStorage that shadows happy-dom's and breaks the leaveWipe tests
